{{Quote|Garrison your workers and ready your fighting Wookiees!|Qui-Gon Jinn to Chewbacca when the camp was attacked|audio=GarrisonWorkers.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
'''Chewbacca's camp''' was built on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]] by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]]. It was run from a central [[command center]] and initially contained buildings used for collecting resources, along with two [[Power core/Legends|power cores]] and a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]]. The camp was run by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], the leader of the Wookiees on Alaris Prime, and was a short distance from a [[Shoran's camp|camp]] run by [[Gender/Legends|his]] ally [[Shoran]]. It was expanded to include a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] for trading resources with Shoran's camp and a [[Jedi temple (Alaris Prime)|Jedi temple]] to store a [[Jedi holocron (Alaris Prime)|holocron]] that was discovered. After dealing with an [[Attack on Chewbacca's camp|attack]] from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] on the camp, Chewbacca and his fellow Wookiees [[Attack on the Trade Federation listening array|destroyed]] a nearby [[Trade Federation listening array]].

==Description==
{{Quote|First things first, have your workers build a spaceport.|Qui-Gon Jinn to Chewbacca|audio=BuildASpaceport.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] camp was built on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]]. The camp occupied a clearing within one of Alaris Prime's lush [[Forest/Legends|forests]], and its initial layout comprised of ten buildings. In the center of the camp were the [[command center]], a [[food processing center]] surrounded by three [[Farm/Legends|farms]], and a [[Power core/Legends|power core]]. Another power core lay to the south, and three [[prefab shelter]]s and an [[animal nursery]] were placed near the [[Tree/Legends|forest]] to the west. At the northern entrance of the camp was a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]] and a [[carbon processing center]]. Two key buildings were later added to the camp, a [[Jedi temple (Alaris Prime)|Jedi temple]] and a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], both within the range of the camp's power cores so they could run efficiently. More prefab shelters were also added to the base<ref name="GB" /> to support its growing population of at least thirty-seven [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].<ref name="Prima" />

[[File:Alaris_Temple.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Jedi temple was built in the camp.]]
Various natural resources were available in the camp, including sources of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] in the form of [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]] [[Bush/Legends|bushes]] and [[Fish/Legends|fish]] from the accessible [[Water/Legends|water]] sources. Deposits of [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] and [[Ore/Legends|ore]] were present on the northeast side, and [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] could be gathered from the many trees. Surrounding the camp were a lake to the south and a line of cliffs next to a river in the east. The area north of the camp led to a larger clearing, where another [[Shoran's camp|camp]] run by Chewbacca's fellow [[Colonist/Legends|colonist]] [[Shoran]] was located.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Jedi Council has just granted us approval to build a Jedi temple on Alaris Prime.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=CouncilApproves.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The camp was established during the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] for control of Alaris Prime fought between the Wookiee [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] and the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]<ref name="GB" /> between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /> After a successful [[Attack on the Trade Federation outpost|attack]] on a [[Trade Federation outpost]], Chewbacca, the leader of the colonists, resided at the camp along with two [[bowcaster trooper]]s, a [[dragon trooper]], seven Wookiee workers, and two [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to the Wookiees, told Chewbacca to set his workers to gather the available resources from the camp while he lectured on the benefit of having allies, believing that to be a key advantage that the Wookiees had over the Trade Federation. Chewbacca had his workers build a spaceport, which allowed the Wookiees to access [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] technology so that they could find Shoran's camp. The Wookiees then built [[Corellian HoverFreighter]]s at the spaceport to exchange goods with the spaceport in Shoran's camp, particularly nova crystals.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Chewie_camp_attack.png|thumb|left|250px|The camp was attacked by the Trade Federation.]]
Shoran found a [[Jedi holocron (Alaris Prime)|Jedi holocron]] within his camp. In response, Jinn asked the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], the ruling body of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], for permission to build a [[Jedi temple/Legends|temple]] on Alaris Prime to store it, which was granted. Chewbacca's workers built the temple in the camp, after which Jinn's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], arrived on Alaris Prime. Kenobi walked to Shoran's camp to retrieve the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], but once he reached it Shoran spotted a group of Trade Federation [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], three [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|beetle droids]], and six [[Battle Droid Beta Version]]s heading for Chewbacca's camp. Shoran warned Jinn and Chewbacca, causing Jinn to suggest that Chewbacca sound the alarm to send his workers to the command center and prepare his fighting Wookiees at the edge of the camp.<ref name="GB" /> A group of between five and six Wookiees<ref name="Prima" /> [[Attack on Chewbacca's camp|destroyed]] all the attacking [[Droid/Legends|droids]], after which Kenobi returned with the holocron and placed it within the temple.<ref name="GB" />

One of Shoran's [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] discovered a [[Trade Federation listening array|listening array]] belonging to the Trade Federation, which Chewbacca suggested the Wookiees destroy. At the camp, he rallied a force<ref name="GB" /> of between eight and thirty fighting Wookiees<ref name="Prima" /> and marched through Shoran's camp to reach the listening array, which was [[Attack on the Trade Federation listening array|destroyed]] along with all the battle droids there.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chewbacca's camp was first mentioned in the [[Prima Games]]' [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]]<ref name="Prima" />&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> It appeared in the sixth level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign titled "Allies and Jedi." The player can place the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] temple and spaceport in any location of their choosing, and can also build other structures aside from those already included in the level, such as [[Shipyard (water)|shipyards]], [[Mech/Legends|mech]] [[Factory/Legends|factories]], and [[Sentry tower/Legends|sentry posts]].<ref name="GB" />
